]

    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries",
]

]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/manaskumar1704/opencode-toolkit"

[project.scripts]
octk = "octk.cli:main"
octk-mcp = "octk.server:main"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.25",
    "ruff>=0.17,<1",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"
line-length = 100
# Vendored third-party skill scripts are not ours to rewrite.

]

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=75"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["."]
include = ["octk*"]
exclude = ["tests*", "benchmarks*", "docs*"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
